children: may test a support at $4,340 per ounce, with a good chance of breaking below this level and falling toward the $4,275-$4,300 range.
The metal failed twice to break a resistance at $4,406. The failures suggest the formation of a top and the completion of a bounce from $4,235.
Signals may not necessarily turn bullish if the market stabilizes around $4,340. Only a break above $4,406 could confirm the extension of the bounce toward the $4,446-$4,474 range.
On the daily chart, the bounce seems to have lost its momentum around a resistance at $4,411. The metal may either retrace toward $4,322 or resume its downtrend from $4,696.
The bounce has defined a neutral range of $4,233-$4,411. Trending signals will become clearer when the market gets out of the range.
